text_block_list.text:
One day, while continuing our training for 
the upcoming debut raceâ

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan☆ That's 3 laps on the dirt 
track done!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ehehe~♪ Maya's not tired yet, so the~re!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hey hey, what are we gonna do next?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Judging by the menu so far, are we just 
gonna breeze through it today~?

—Just as she said, this time I had 
structured the routine primarily around 
softer dirt tracks.

Mayano Top Gun's body is still growing. I 
had intended not to put too much strain on 
her legs, but...
choice_data_list:
Do you want to push yourself a little 
more?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: "Nope! 'A little' isn't enough!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Because Maya's going to be in the Twinkle 
Series, you know!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
It's overflowing with excitement and 
things I want to understand, and everyone 
running in the race is sparkling so 
brightly...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
If I get to run in the Twinkle Series, of 
course I wanna get faster!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, b-e-s-i-d-e-s~...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"You think Maya can 'do even better' too, 
right, Trainer-chan?"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yay, Maya got it totally right~☆

And so, without changing our core 
approach, we decided to try out various 
kinds of training, but—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Race research. Re-search... huh...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha♪ I feel like I'm sprinting right up 
the staircase to adulthood☆
choice_data_list: This is training too, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, I know☆ Besides, Maya's super 
good at this kinda thing!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Huh, is the video already over? It's only 
been 30 minutes!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I get it! This is your plan to keep 
Maya on the edge of her seat, isn't it~

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Th-is is... adult negotiations☆ 
...Eeeek☆"
Even so—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer-chan. I'm done watching this 
video!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Number 1 makes an early swoop around the 
3rd corner and zooms right past them, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yup. Because I've totally figured it out. 
Wanna check our answers and see if I'm 
right?

Prompted to do so, I fast-forward through 
the footage to check...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: See~☆ Just like Maya said~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, let's move on to the next one! Next 
up!!

And just like that, we ended up watching 
all of the prepared race footage to the 
end...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ayaya? Trainer-chan. Are we really done 
already?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I gotcha~! That kind of development is 
super welcome too☆

“—And so, this time we came to the pool to 
improve our cardiopulmonary endurance.”

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Umm, we're measuring how far we can go 
without taking a breath, right!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
By the way! How well do I have to do for 
you to praise me and say Maya's the best?

"...Typically, with enough practice, one 
can reach 75 meters. So on the first 
try... 100 meters would be quite 
impressive."

However, it is said that an Umamusume once 
reached 300 meters in the past. Since we 
have the chance—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: "Eye copy! Alright, off I go!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Phew~...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Geez, why~!? I could only make it 
halfway~!!"

However, half—150 meters is still plenty 
impressive. If you build up your practice 
little by little from now on, eventually, 
300 meters will be...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Mmmgh, all right, one more time!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'm going for the full 300 
meters☆
choice_data_list: It's only the second time, you know!?
It's only our second time, you know!?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yeah, it's already my second time.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Plus, while swimming, I figured out the 
trick to exerting my strength☆"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ehehe♪ I'm gonna go try it out right away!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ah!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan! Once I finish this, give me 
another new assignment, okay? Pretty 
please♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Nihihi☆ You copy?

"...And in order to meet her demands, I 
ended up racking my brain desperately."
